title: feat(full-core): persist D6 classified event-stream acquisition
body:
## Summary
- Persist typed classified event-stream acquisition in the existing equity-authority owner package, bound to D4 identity and the D5 checkpoint observation by reference/digest.
- Keep completeness UNPROVEN: census found an empty ratified classified kind set and no authorized productive event-source GET seam. Absence of events is not a zero-event complete stream.
- Fail-closed for UNKNOWN/UNCLASSIFIED, missing source, gaps, duplicates, order ambiguity, and equity mutation. No venue GET/POST, no reconstruction engine, no C17, no source mapping. D7 is not released.

## Test plan
- [x] Bounded D6 / D5 / D4 / OPTION_D / owner tests (`38 passed`)
- [x] Repo-conform PR-bounded selector targets (`744 passed` in 37.10s)
- [x] `ruff format --check` and `ruff check` on D6 Python
- [x] Docs token policy and docs-reference-targets on changed Markdown
- [ ] GitHub required checks (snapshot only; no merge)
